children: Volkswagen Group's management plans to discontinue its Seat brand by 2029, business news outlet WirtschaftsWoche reported Thursday, citing a confidential document prepared for the group's supervisory board, which will convene this week.
Seat's sister brand, Cupra, will continue, WirtschaftsWoche added.
